name: pi-btw
notes: Local divergence: extensions/btw.ts migrates the hand-written transcript state machine (~200 lines) to the shared @xzzpig/pi-components builder API (appendEntry/ensureTurn/finishTurn/findLatestEntry/ensureToolCall/upsertText/upsertToolResult/removeTranscriptTurn/hasStreamingTranscriptEntry); entry/state types now alias the library's TranscriptEntry/TranscriptState. Behavior-equivalent (58/58 tests match pre-migration baseline). @xzzpig/pi-components is bundled via bundledDependencies (private, never published to npm); the pin tracks the bundled workspace version and is 0.4.0 since that release added appendText/appendAssistantMessage and TranscriptRenderOptions.hideThinkingBlock (btw keeps its upsertText usage and the expanded default, so no btw source change was needed). Intentional local-only change; upstream has no dependency on @xzzpig/pi-components. v0.5.0 sync: fork keeps the pi-components migration on top of the upstream rewrite; upstream's own overlay renderer (buildOverlayTranscript + per-entry helpers) was NOT adopted, rendering stays on pi-components renderTranscriptLines (markdown-aware). Turn outcomes (completed/aborted/failed) were added as an optional `outcome` field on turn-boundary entries in @xzzpig/pi-components (TranscriptTurnOutcome; finishTurn third parameter); upstream's markdownTheme/managesMouseReporting/rebuildTranscriptLines additions were dropped with the self-implemented renderer, and SGR mouse-reporting + fork's ownsMouseReporting field remain fork-only. Re-apply the migration/outcome threading on each future sync.
